text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I would like permission to undergo a special training journey!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although we have no races or photo shoots today, Sakura Chiyono O comes up to me in her signature racewear to make a puzzling request.
choice_data_list: Why do you want to do that?
Why do you want to do that?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Because I want to become a lady who embodies traditional Japanese ideals!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I asked for my signature racewear to be designed with Japanese aesthetics and a cherry blossom motif…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But I'm not very ladylike… or samurai-like…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I like Japanese desserts and sumo wrestling, but just liking them doesn't make me worthy of wearing my signature racewear!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's why I want the Yamato Nadeshiko Squad to put me through my paces!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Grass and Yaeno, I mean! I always think of them as being super refined, so I call them the Yamato Nadeshiko Squad.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I'm sure that between the two of them, they can make me into a proper Japanese lady!
choice_data_list: You don't need to go that far…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: But I want to go that far!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Putting on my signature racewear reminds me of how I felt when I entered the academy.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I stepped through the gates so proud and sure that this would be the place I'd explode into full bloom…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: My signature racewear is the embodiment of that wish I made, so I want to wear it with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And once I have that confidence, I'm sure I'll truly blossom in it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While the idea still comes off a little strange, her intentions are good, so I set aside time in her schedule for her to do her special training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, by the way, I wanted to ask…Which of them do you think I should ask for help? Grass or Yaeno?
choice_data_list: Ask Grass Wonder, the epitome of Japanese grace and beauty.
Ask Yaeno Muteki, the disciplined warrior.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Grass's way of speaking and mannerisms are so precise and wonderful. I wish I could be like her… ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: E… excuse me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you for agreeing to help me, Grass! Now, as for today's training, what were you—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky, the Beast.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: You and I are both chasing after the same great opponent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: But is that blade of yours sharpened? Allow me to test your abilities!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gyahhh?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …Just kidding.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You seemed so nervous, so I decided to play a little prank on you to lighten the mood.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-oh, I see! So that was a joke!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Haha. That surprised me. I should have known you weren't that scary.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I heard you like Japanese desserts, so I thought we could have some with green tea. Now, shall we talk?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I too am still on my journey to become a proper Japanese lady, so let us discuss the methods by which we can achieve our ideals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They indulge in desserts and tea… Or rather, they hold a tea ceremony under Grass Wonder's tutelage and pass the time tranquilly.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Why, good morning to you, my dear Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Oh, my, do you think so? Perhaps I've gotten closer to being a proper Japanese lady. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What do you say we go visit some shrines and temples sometime? Grass informed me of some nice ones we can go see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the easily influenced Sakura Chiyono O seems to have picked up on Grass Wonder's way of speaking. It sticks with her for quite a while after their meeting.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno! I'm sure training with her won't be easy, but I'll just have to come prepared!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm still inexperienced myself and am in no position to teach you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, I understand well your desire for strength. As such, I shall instruct you to the best of my abilities.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Strength… Yes, that's right! Thank you for agreeing to help me. Let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Before we engage in our training, we must thoroughly wipe down the space we are about to use in order to show appreciation for it…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Let us go over the floors one hundred times. Surely then they will be clean.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Pant… We're finished!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whew… Well done. Now, about the actual training…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Before we start it, let's do a hundred punches to get your body accustomed to the exercise.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Hyah, hyah… Huff!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wheeeze! Huff… A… a hundred punches… done!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: A wonderful job. Now, as for the actual training…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: We will not be doing any.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wait, what?! We're calling it quits already?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Does this mean… there's no hope for me?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Quite the opposite. You did well today, so I see no need for training. You are already plenty strong.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: What? Strong? Me? But I'm so out of breath.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The strength I speak of is your mental fortitude. Within your heart is the resilience to keep pushing yourself to be who you want to be…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Once you realize that for yourself, you will be able to walk with confidence without having to learn from someone like me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yaeno…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The world of martial arts is one fraught with dangers, but if you truly wish to enter it… do not hesitate to reach out to me again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Should that time ever come, I shall welcome you with open arms. Thank you very much for today.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: No, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O bows smartly, the profile of her face shining with a little more confidence than before.
